text: Introduction Industrial Engineering (IE) is an interdisciplinary comprehensive engineering subject between hard technology and management technology. Oriented by reducing the cost, improving the quality and productivity, and realizing the sustainable development, IE, adopting method of systematization, specialization and science, identifies, forecasts and evaluates the operation and effect of the integrated system composed of man, material, machine, energy and information through using multiple hard technology and management technology. Educational Requirements 1. Systematically mastering the basic theories, methods and profession knowledge of IE, 2. Well understanding modern engineering economy and modern project management theory, 3. Mastering the advanced technology and means of dealing with the project technology problem, 4. Being able to analyze and handle realistic operation problems by using above theories and methods Research Orientation Ergonomics Technology and Application, Logistics Technology and System Simulation in Modern Production Environment, Production Operation and Enterprise Information Technology. Note: Masters' Degree Programs for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Award Students are required to complete the curriculum in 2.5, fulfill the designated degree courses, complete the master's thesis and defend of it in front of a panel of experts. Graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the Master’s degree.
